*   Flawlessly obey the instruction without hallucinating or drifting.

"Usually" is a dangerous word in cybersecurity. AI agents operate at machine speed; a human analyst operates at human speed.

*   Furthermore, having a human "nearby" (human-*on*-the-loop) is vastly different from requiring explicit human authorization before execution (human-*in*-the-loop).
